summary: Frontend re-test of iteration_3 CRITICAL fix + 3 regressions. PS5 Controller Builder variant ids are now valid (product_id:index), selection/highlight/summary/total/live photo tint/toggle-deselect and both save flows all work. DualSense + Edge both render real photos with valid variant ids. Admin category cascade delete works (option removed, no orphan; unknown id -> 404). Light-theme FinalCTA button is white-on-dark (readable). FAQ text now 'Wie funktioniert der PC Builder?'. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Stored/returned total has float artefact (111.80000000000001). Round to 2 decimals server-side.

ui_bugs.issue: Confirm dialog copy is now wrong/misleading: 'Optionen dieser Kategorie bleiben bestehen...' while backend cascades and deletes the options. Update wording to warn about option deletion.

action_items: Fix misleading confirm text in AdminConfigurator.delCat (options ARE deleted now)
Round builder total to 2 decimals in /api/builder/save
critical_code_review_comments: ControllerBuilder relies on variant.id from API; consider a defensive fallback key (product.id + index) in the client so a backend serialization regression cannot silently break selection again.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted temp PC Builder category 'TEST_Cascade' with option 'TEST_Orphan Option'. Saved 2 builder configs (GUoj3whVfU4, O0gkh7S9xMg) - harmless demo configs. No seeded data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: variant testids look like builder-variant-<24hexid>:<idx>, 0 'undefined'. Tint layers over img[alt=Controller] have mixBlendMode color/multiply/screen with the chosen color_hex. Saved config GET /api/builder/config/{id} contains variant_id 'xxxx:4'. Consent banner (consent-accept) must be dismissed. Admin configurator route: /admin/konfigurator, PC tab data-testid cfg-tab-pc.
rca_of_the_issue: iteration_3 bug (variant.id undefined) is resolved at source in backend/app/routers/builder.py which now injects v['id'] = f"{product_id}:{index}"; frontend pick()/active check by variant.id now behaves correctly.
